entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man. Suuure must be nice not[n]having to go to school.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A dead man cannot go to[n]school, you know.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This would all be for nothing if[n]they found out he's still alive.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Doesn't it suck to live like a[n]fugitive, though? Always having[n]to hide your face?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm sure it is... No doubt it's hard[n]as well, but please bear with it[n]for now.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Are you all right? You really[n]needn't cover your eyes...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Don't try too hard to hide yourself.[n]You'll only stand out more.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's always the hardest.[n]"Try hard, but not too hard..."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In any case, we're ready to put[n]the plan into action. Now all we[n]need is your signal.
